sections.passage: Last Thursday, our school held a talent show in the hall. Huda played a lively tune on her drum while her friends sang. After the music, Salma read a poem that she had written about her grandmother. She was nervous at first, but the audience listened carefully. Later, Nasser played the piano, and Mariam painted a picture beside the stage. A teacher took photographs for the school website, but she asked the performers for permission first. The show began at three o'clock and finished at five. The students put away the instruments and cleaned the hall before going home.

sections.passage: My grandfather showed me some photographs of his childhood last weekend. His school was small and had only three classrooms. The children walked there because their families did not own cars. He used a pencil and paper to write his lessons. There were no computers or digital boards. After school, he played football in an empty field. His family had an old camera, but they waited several days before the pictures were printed. Today I travel to a larger school by bus. I use a computer during science lessons and can take pictures with a phone. My grandfather says that many things have changed, but good friends and hard work are important in every generation.

questions.script: A: What is the science team building for the fair? B: We are making a rocket model from recycled paper. We will show how a real rocket travels into space. A: Will it actually fly? B: No, it is just a model for our display.

questions.stem: Text 2
questions.script: A: How will we look at stars on Friday evening? B: We will use a telescope. It makes distant objects in the sky easier to see. A: Can I look directly at the Sun through it? B: Never! That is dangerous.

questions.stem: Text 3
questions.script: A: What are those eight round objects on your poster? B: They represent the planets in our solar system. Earth is one of them, and they all move around the Sun. A: Shall we add their names? B: Yes, below the pictures.

questions.stem: Text 4
questions.script: A: Why is the astronaut wearing special clothes? B: It is a spacesuit. It protects the astronaut outside a spacecraft. A: Could we wear ordinary jackets in space? B: No, they would not protect us.

questions.stem: Text 5
questions.script: A: What is the bright shape in the night sky? B: It is the Moon, Earth's natural satellite. A: Does it make its own light? B: No, it reflects sunlight.

sections.script: Interviewer: Welcome to Young Space Explorers. What will your class make for the science fair, Mariam? Mariam: A large model of the solar system. Mariam: A telescope on the school roof. Interviewer: What will you do before the exhibition? Mariam: We will check that every planet has the correct name. Interviewer: When will the exhibition open? Mariam: On Thursday morning.

sections.passage: Dear Space Explorers, Today I am writing about our visit to the science centre. At first we saw a large model of the solar system. The guide explained that eight planets move around the Sun and that Earth is one of them. We watched a short video about astronauts living on a space station. They wear spacesuits when they work outside. Later we looked at a telescope, but the guide reminded us never to look directly at the Sun through it. I enjoyed learning about the Moon, which travels around Earth. Next week our class will make a model rocket and write a short blog about the exhibition. I hope we can visit the centre again.

sections.passage: Last Saturday, my friend Ahmed and I went shopping for his sister's birthday. Ahmed had saved five rials in his money box. We looked at the toys first, but the prices were too high. Then we visited the bookshop, where a friendly assistant showed us some adventure stories. Ahmed chose a colourful book that cost three rials. He kept the receipt and put the book in his cloth bag. We walked past the bakery and looked at the cakes, but we did not buy anything else. Ahmed decided to save the remaining two rials. His sister was delighted with the book, and Ahmed was happy that he had stayed within his budget.
